an10.100:1.1: C. Dasa yime bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame dasa? Rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ kodhaṃ upanāhaṃ makkhaṃ paḷāsaṃ issaṃ macchariyaṃ mānaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an10.100:2.1: Dasa yime bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame dasa? Rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ kodhaṃ upanāhaṃ makkhaṃ paḷāsaṃ issaṃ macchariyaṃ mānaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātun ti. Upāsakavaggo dasamo.
an10.100:3.0: Tatr' uddānaṃ: Kāmabhogī veraṃ diṭṭhi Vajjiya-Uttiyā ubho Kokanudo āhuniyo thero Upāli abhabbo ti. Dutiyapaṇṇāsako niṭṭhito.
